name: pyrechat
description: PyreChat — Snapchat-class camera messenger. Orange, skull, zero moderation.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.apk:publish: npm run android && wrangler r2 object put pyrechat-media/app/pyrechat.apk --file android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk --content-type application/vnd.android.package-archive --remote
scripts.ios: echo "Build IPA on macOS: chmod +x scripts/build-ios-ipa.sh && scripts/build-ios-ipa.sh"
scripts.ipa:publish: scripts/build-ios-ipa.sh && wrangler r2 object put pyrechat-media/app/pyrechat.ipa --file ios/build/PyreChat.ipa --content-type application/octet-stream --remote
